summary: Reproduced stale oversized EAGLE and DFlash custom masks after a grow-then-shrink batch sequence on gfx950. The fix pads a local mask, preserves existing mask values, returns an exact-length slice, and never stores padding back on the verify input.

tests.what_was_measured: On the base, EAGLE returned 462 elements when 66 were required and DFlash returned 168 when 24 were required; after the fix both returned the exact required lengths and retained no padding. Raw summary: reports/j-2a0185bbbe7b/reproduction.txt; full captured output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-2a0185bbbe7b/repro-before.txt and /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-2a0185bbbe7b/repro-after.txt.

Five GPU regression/boundary cases passed for exact output length, preservation of nontrivial False/True mask prefixes, no mutation of retained masks, allocation-free shrink views, and DFlash custom_mask=None. Full output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-2a0185bbbe7b/test-after.txt.
